direct_manipulation: Diagnosis commit and evidence selection are both direct taps on the card itself (or its commit button) with immediate visual feedback (border/background color change, checkmark) — verified live via click-and-screenshot in the Browser pane.
reaction_timing: State updates (commit highlight, evidence toggle, submit feedback) render synchronously on tap with no artificial delay, consistent with every other Q1 game in this app.
c_to_d: Verified: the 6 evidence cards (話/診察/呼吸状態/検査/画像/循環) and 4 diagnosis candidates' typical-pattern text (fact_sheet.candidate_reference_cards, opened via the '?' circle) are the only information available; the child must compare them and commit — the component never auto-suggests or highlights a correct pairing (gameplay-qa-clue-join.mjs: 'CORRECT_DIAGNOSIS is never used before the success screen').
consequence: A winning submission (pneumonia + an evidence set that is a superset of {lab,xray} and subset of {lab,xray,talk,exam}) shows a distinct success screen contrasting the 3 other candidates and explicitly notes why spo2/bp were not decisive; a losing submission returns one flat, uninformative sentence with no diagnosis/evidence-specific hint (verified live and by gameplay-qa-clue-join.mjs's answer-leak/random-guess-rate checks). v2 fix (CLINICAL_MODEL_OVERSTATED): the 3-alternative contrast on the success screen no longer states absolute exclusion ('○○ではない'); it now shows '○○との比較' followed by that candidate's own fact_sheet-sourced tendency text and a single comparative sentence ('今回そろった所見は、これよりも肺炎の典型像によく合う。'), preserving fact_sheet_v12's non-absolute/tendency-only framing — re-verified live end to end after the fix.
retry: Within budget (2 attempts), a wrong submission decrements the counter shown on the submit button ('あと1回') and lets the child freely re-commit/re-select with the SAME shuffled order (no reshuffle mid-session) — verified live. After budget exhaustion, the honest partial screen offers both 'もう一度考える' (resets budget to 2, reshuffles orders, verified live) and '先へ進む' (calls onPartialComplete, verified live — Job Reveal still fires).
answer_leak: gameplay-qa-clue-join.mjs verifies: no diagnosis candidate's read-only pattern text contains a verdict phrase or names another candidate; CORRECT_DIAGNOSIS is never referenced before the outcome is decided; the per-session shuffle is id-based (scoring never touches display position). Live testing confirmed the '?' pattern disclosure never reveals or implies which candidate is correct.
brute_force: gameplay-qa-clue-join.mjs: select_all / has-number-only / no-number-only heuristics all win 0% of simulated cases (N=8000); blind random evidence+diagnosis stays at 3.06% (matches design-sim.mjs's disclosed theoretical baseline); the r2-class fixed-position exploit (first-displayed candidate + evidence positions 1,2,4,5) matches the chance baselines 1/60 (single try) and 1/30 (2-try cycled), i.e. no better than blind guessing once shuffled.
visual_affordance: Committed diagnosis card and selected evidence cards both get a clear orange border/background change plus a checkmark; the disabled submit button (before any diagnosis is committed) is visually dimmed via the existing btn:disabled opacity rule; the '?' disclosure is now a visibly bordered circular button rather than bare text — verified live via screenshot.
no_manual: No instructional/how-to-play text anywhere in the screen; card meaning is discoverable via tap and the '?' disclosure only, matching no_manual_exploit_check_v9.json and every sibling Q1 game's convention.
job_reveal: onComplete/onPartialComplete both route to the existing shared Q1 shell, which renders medical.ts's unchanged med-diagnose discoveryEcho/resolution/seed-picker — verified live end to end (success path reached the '🎉 肺で炎症が起きている可能性が高い' discoveryEcho screen; ch4 flipped from active to done and ch5 med-pharm unlocked).
